tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// chos sman gyi dkar chag gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī ye/ chu gter bsrubs pa'i snying po min yang rgyal kun thugs mtsho'i snying po can// lus med lam du 'phye ba min yang mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od kun nas 'bar// 'dam skyes lang tshor mdza' ba min yang 'gro blo'i pad tshal rgyas par byed// pad 'byung dam pa'i snang ba khyod kyis rtag par dge ba'i bshes mdzod cig /de yang phan bde'i 'byung gnas dam pa rnams kyi gdul bya rigs can gsum la sogs pa rnams 'dul ba'i don du dam pa'i chos ji snyed cig gsungs pa'i snying por gyur pa gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam srol chen po nyid la'ang*/ o ḍi yā na dang 'phags pa'i yul sogs su gsar rnying gi dbye ba ma grags kyang*/ gangs ri'i khrod 'dir snga 'gyur dang phyi 'gyur gnyis su byung ba'i phyi ma ni dam par rlom pa 'ga'i chos tshong dus kyi 'o ma ltar gyur pa shin tu mang la/ snga ma la'ang bka' gter gnyis su nges pa la/ brgyud pa drug dang ldan pa/ rang bzo'i lhad med pa byin rlabs kyi phabs ma nyams pa ni gsang sngags gter nas byon pa rnams kho nar nges la/ de la'ang lho gter/ byang gter gnyis las/ lho gter rnams ni 'bras bu'i tshul du bzhugs pa las de'i nang nas kyang mnga' bdag yab sras la slob dpon chen pos zab pa las kyang ches zab pa g.yar dam bgyi ba'i chos su gsungs pa/ dbus ri nag po'i ltongs su ri rin chen 'bar ba'i ngos o rgyan sgrub phug tu gsang gter du bzhugs pa/ rig 'dzin chen po sangs rgyas gling pas spyan drangs pa bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa zhes nyi zla ltar grags pa skor tsho chen po gsum du bzhugs pa'i bskyed rim gyi skor las| yan lag dngos grub bdud rtsi'i sgrub pa drug gi nang tshan sman gyi sgrub pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho zhes dam rdzas khyad par can rmad du byung bar gsungs pa/ myong grol chen po chos sman 'di nyid kyi phabs rgyun du bzhugs pa'i rim pa ni/

ston pa sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung gsum/ o rgyan rin po che'i dbu skra dang za ber gyi tshal pa/ o rgyan rin po che'i chos gos pad+ma gling pa'i gter ma/ o rgyan rin po che la za hor rgyal pos phul ba'i za ber gyi tshal pa chos rgyal dri med lhun po'i gter ma/ o rgyan rin po che'i phyag phreng*/ maud+gal gyi bu'i gdung rus/ siṅga gling pa'i dgra bcom pa'i tshems dang na bza'/ rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i sku 'bag dang tshems/ rje btsun rat+na'i sku sha dang phyag phreng*/ sku chos/ pur ras/ dbu lo/ rje phag gru'i phya'u dang chab bzod dum bu/ dbu zhwa/ bzhugs gdan/ phyag phreng*/ kun skyong gling pa'i gdung rus/ byang chub ljon shing*/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i phyag phreng*/ kong smyon 'jam dpal bzang po'i gdung rus/ mnga' bdag nyang gi shog ser dang*/ dbu lo/ gter rdzas khyung sen/ rje btsun chos rgyal phun tshogs kyi sku sha dang*/ sku mtshal/ dbu skra/ na bza'/ phyag phreng*/ jo bo rje'i phyag dpe dang srog sgril/ zhwa dmar chos kyi grags pa'i phyag phreng dang pur ras/ tshems/ kong po mgon po rol pa'i thugs sras zla ba'i phya'u/ rje nyer brgyad pa'i dbu zhwa dang phyag phreng*/ sgam po pa bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi phyag phreng dang gsang chab/ tshems/ gdung rus/ bram ze skye ba bdun pa'i gdung rus/ rtogs ldan dka' thub pa'i sgom thag /grub chen dza har pir gyi zhal tshoms dang zhal skyogs/ mkha' 'gro ma bsod nams dpal 'dren gyi gdung rus dang dbu klad/ sangs rgyas gling pa'i dbu skra dang na bza'/ phyag phreng*/ shog ser/ dge bshes po to ba'i thugs/ paṇa chen nā ro pa'i dbu skra dang snyan rgyan/ rje mar pa'i dbu skra dang zhal skyogs/ rje rang byung rdo rje'i dbu zhwa dang gdung rus/ mnga' ris rig 'dzin bdud 'joms rdo rje'i tshems dang dbu zhwa/ dbu lo/ byang sems dkar dmar/ tsā rir gnyos chen po la mkha' 'gro mas dngos grub kyi baṃ ro gsum phul ba'i sku sha/

gnyos chen po'i gzim khri 'phur shes kyi dum bu/ tsā rir gnyos chen po la mkha' 'gro ma su kha sid+dhis rgya gar nas 'bras kyi snye ma dang a ru ra blangs nas phul ba/ dpal tsā ri tra'i mtsho rnams kyi chu dang*/ rde'u dang*/ sin+dhu ra ka la ma tshang ba med pa/ dpal rga lo'i na bza' dang gdung rus/ ma cig lab sgron gyi na bza'/ mtsho ma dros ba'i chu/ bai ro tsa na'i dbu skra gter byon dang phyag dpe/ khams ra la'i rnam snang gi sku 'dam/ 'or bu byams pa'i sku 'dam/ ma ga dha'i rten ma hā bo dhi'i sku 'dam/ mchod rten bya rung kha shor gyi so phag /mchod rten rnam dag gi sa/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi sa sna/ ra sa 'phrul snang gi lha rang byung lnga ldan gyi sku 'dam/ spyan snga grags 'byung gi phya'u dang bzhugs gdan/ paṇa chen shākya shrī'i snam sbyar dang gaṇ+ḍi/ chos rje paṇa chen gyi gdung rus/ zhwa dmar ba dkon mchog yan lag gi sku sha/ dwags po sgom tshul gyi phya'u/ paṇ+ḍi ta smṛ ti'i mchod rten gyi sa/ sho sgom gyi phyag tsha/ karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa'i dbu klad ring srel dang phya'u/ bla ma zhang gi phya'u/ zhang ka ma pa'i na bza'/ se skyel phu pa'i snam sbyar/ bcom ldan rig ral gyi gdung rus/ stag tshang lo tsā ba'i gdung rus/ rgyal ba thog thub pa'i na bza'/ rje kun dga' rin chen gyi tshems dang phya'u/ paṇa chen shākya mchog gi gsang chab/ kaḥthog pa rdo rje bzang po'i gdung rus/ bya khyung pa dpal ldan seng ge'i dbu lo dang dbu klad/ gdung rus/ phyag phreng*/ rtsa gsum sgrub ril/ bya khyung pa dpal 'bar dbang phyug gi gdung rus/ rtsa gsum ril bu/ bya khyung pa ngag dbang pad+ma'i gdung rus/ dbu lo/ des bsgrubs pa'i rtsa gsum sgrub ril dang skye bdun/ chos rgyal rin chen dpal bzang po'i gdung rus dang sku mtshal/ dwags po zla 'od gzhon nu'i dbu lo dang phya'u/ mnga' ris paṇa chen gyi dbu lo dang*/

shog ser dang*/ skye bdun a dam ma/ ma hā nā tha'i zhal tshom/ mkhas grub o rgyan pa'i gdung rus/ stag lung thang pa'i dbu zhwa/ sems dpa' zla ba blo gros kyi gdung rus/ rgya gar phyag na rdo rje'i sgom thag /kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i na bza'/ pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyi dbu lo dang tshems/ thang stong rgyal po'i dbu lo/ bod du 'bum 'gyur ba'i thog ma rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i shang mtshal rgya skyegs dang bsres te/ lo tsā ba 'bang khams pa go chas bris pa thugs 'gyur dmar por grags pa chos rgyal dri med lhun pos gter nas spyan drangs pa'i shog tshal/ chos rgyal dri med lhun po'i sku sha /khri srong lde'u btsan gyi gdung rus dang dbu lo/ sangs rgyas gling pas 'gyer bye ma dkar po nas gdan drangs pa'i tshe ril/ sgam po'i rgyab nas gter ston 'ja' tshon snying pos spyan drangs pa'i dam rdzas/ bya khyung shes rab dpal gyi gdung rus/ paṇ+ḍi ta yid 'ong gi sku sha/ klong chen pa'i sras pad+ma dbang chen gyi sku sha dang dbu lo/ rig 'dzin shrī singha'i dbu lo/ pad+ma gling pa'i tshems dang na bza'/ skye bdun gter ma/ sa skya pa sngags 'chang chen po'i dbu lo/ sangs rgyas gling pa'i sras ye shes rdo rje'i dbu lo/ gter gsar gyi dam rdzas kun 'dus| mkhan chen byams pa chos kyi rgya mtsho'i dbu lo/ gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gi sku sha/ tshe chu 'khrul med/ rat+na gling pa'i sku sha/ skye 'dun a dam ma/ nam mkha'i snying po'i dbu skra/ gter ston mchog ldan mgon pos spyan drangs ba'i skye bdun/ chos bdag nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi dbu skra/ pad+ma gling pa'i thugs sras tshe dbang grags pa'i dbu lo/ o rgyan gling pa'i dbu lo dang gdung rus/ rig 'dzin rgod ldem can gyi dbu lo/ bram ze pad+ma dkar po'i dbu thod o rgyan gling pas spyan drangs pa/ zhig po gling pa'i dbu lo/ yar klung sprul sku'i sku sha/

rje btsun pradzñā rasmi'i phyag zhabs gyi sen mo dang dbu lo/ gter gsar gyi dam rdzas bdud rtsi myong grol/ 'brom ston pa'i dbu lo/ lha sras mu tig btsad po'i dbu lo/ rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje'i dam rdzas rol pa chen po sangs rgyas gling pas gter nas spyan drangs pa/ las 'phro gling pa'i na bza'/ bya khyung pa chos rgyal bkra shis kyi gdung rus| khri srong lde'u btsan gyi na bza' sangs rgyas gling pas rdza dkar dung sgo nas spyan drangs pa/ nyer gnyis pa rin po che'i dbu lo/ chab ser/ 'phel gdung*/ rje nā ro pas mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod nas kyang spyan drangs pa'i dam rdzas myong grol mnyam med dwags pos brag sgom zhu'i 'og tu sbas pa gter gsar/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi bdud rtsi ril bu stong rdo| |rje sa chen gyi bdud rtsi ril bu brgya rdo/ sa paṇ+ḍi ta'i sku mtshal/ sras dar ma mdo sde'i dbu klad kyi ring bsrel/ rig 'dzin bdud 'joms rdo rjes bton pa'i skye bdun/ 'brug pa pad+ma dkar po'i sku sha/ khu dbon gsum gyi gdung 'dag dkar dmar/ rgyal ba rgod tshang pa'i gdung rus/ bshes gnyen don grub rgyal po'i gdung rus/ rgyal sras thogs med pa'i na bza'| gcung til+li pa'i rnam 'phrul gyi tshems/ mkhan po bo dhi satwa'i gdung rus/ yang rdzong grub chen ma'i gdung rus/ dol pa zang thal pa'i gdung rus/ bya 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i sku sha/ gu ru chos dbang gi sras pad+ma dbang chen gyi gdung rus/ gter ston pradzñā rasmis zab yang mchod rten dkar po nas spyan drangs ba'i bram ze pad+ma dkar po'i dbu thod dang skye bdun/ yang de nyid kyis zab yang dbu rtse yang steng mdzod nas spyan drangs pa'i skye bdun/ yang de nyid kyis spyan drangs pa'i dam rdzas rol pa chen po/ slar gter ston nyid kyi dam rdzas gter byon rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdoms pa'i ril bu 'ja' zug mar grags pa/

grol tig sgrol ma rang byung gi shog ser/ rje dam pa sangs rgyas kyi gdung dang gdung thal/ ril dkar/ kong chen chos bdag nam mkha' dpal ldan rgya mtsho'i gdung rus/ sras bdud 'dul gyi sku sha/ gzhan yang rang lugs kyi brgyud pa dang dam tshig gi sel med pa'i dam pa gong ma rnams kyi sku bal gyi ring bsrel dpag tu med pa dang khyad par gyi phabs rgyun/ rje btsun rin chen phun tshogs kyis gzho stod gter sgrom brag dkar nas spyan drangs pa'i o rgyan yab yum gyi byang sems dkar dmar/ yang dam pa de nyid kyis glang gdong brag nas gter du bzhes pa'i o rgyan rin po ches bsgrubs pa'i chos sman/ gter gsar gyi gu ru yab yum gyi byang sems dkar dmar/ o rgyan yab yum gyis yar klung shel gyi brag phug tu bsgrubs pa'i chos sman zhig po gling pa'i gter ma/ sangs rgyas gling pa'i sman nag /rat+na gling pa'i chos sman/ las 'phro gling pa'i chos sman/ sras 'gro ba'i mgon po'i chos sman/ rje btsun rin chen phun tshogs kyis bsgrubs pa'i chos sman rigs lnga/ rje btsun chos rgyal phun tshogs kyis bsgrubs pa'i chos sman/ rje btsun maṅga'i mtshan can gyis bsgrubs pa'i chos sman/ rig 'dzin bdud 'joms rdo rjes bsgrubs pa'i chos sman/ bya khyung pa ngag dbang pad+mas bsgrubs pa'i chos sman rigs gsum/ bya khyung pa rgyal dbang pad+ma bstan 'dzin gyis bsgrubs pa'i chos sman rigs gnyis/ bdag rang gis bsgrubs pa'i bka' dgongs kyi chos sman rigs gnyis/ rdo rje slob dpon rang nyid kyis na si rak+ta la sogs pa bskrun par byas pa'i dam rdzas ma tshang ba med pa rnams yongs su 'du ba bgyis pa dag /sman gyi rtsa ba brgyad rigs rnam pa lnga'i zlas phye ba'i rtsa ba bzhi la skyob dang 'phrod 'bras bur bcas pa dang*/ rgyu lnga bsgral ba'i rdzas dang*/ brtan g.yo zhu ba dang mi zhu ba'i khams las grub pa yod dgu dang*/

rgyu dang mi rgyu ba yod do cog gi dngos po 'du bgyi ba'i yan lag stong rigs drug gis phye ba'i stong phrag drug la sogs par yongs su sbyar te/ gter byon nyid kyi dbang sgrub gyi dpe dang*/ dam pa gong ma rnams kyi phyag len gyi gnad ma 'khrul bar rnam dpyod kyi shes rab rnam par bkra ba'i mig gis mngon par dpyad cing bskyed rdzogs kyi gnad la dbang 'byor bar bgyis te/ dkar po zhes pa 'byung ba lnga ldan sa mo sprul gyi lo cho 'phrul gyi zla ba'i phyogs snga ma'i dga' ba dang po nas/ bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po zhal phye ste/ sman khrol bu sbyang ba'i rim pa rnams zhag gsum la legs par grub par bgyis nas stong pa dang po'i dus tshes dge bar/ khrol bu sbyangs pa paṇa chen nā ro pa'i zhal skyogs la gzhal ba'i khal gcig dang thod pa bdun byung ba gong bur bsdus pa bdag cag bcu phrag gcig gis tshul dang mthun par sgrub pa'i tshe zhag gcig nas sman gyi dri chil gyis byung zhing*/ zhag gsum nas sman gyi dris khyab pa dang*| sngags kyi rang sgra sgrog pa bdag cag kun gyis mngon gsum du thos pa byung yang*/ zhag bcu gcig bsgrubs te zla ba de nyid kyi phyogs snga'i rdzogs pa gsum pa'i tho rangs sid+dhi sgrub dbang sogs tshul mthun du bgyis nas/ dmar cha'i dga' ba dang po'i snga dror zhal phye ba'i tshe a ru ra'i dbyibs lta bu kha dog dang dri ngad sogs ltas phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ paṇa chen nā ro pa'i zhal skyogs lnga 'phel ba sogs ya mtshan gyi ltas dpag tu med pa dang bcas bskrun pa'i dam rdzas 'di ni dam pa gong ma re re'i sku gdung gi cha shas kyang myong grol gyi rang bzhin can dang*/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga tsam yang gsang sngags nang pa'i dam rdzas kyi gtso bor gsungs na/ 'di lta bu kun 'dus chos sman dam rdzas dam pa 'di ni myong ba don ldan kho nar nges so// ji skad du/

yon tan kun ldan rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rdzas// khyad par rmad du byung ba'i ra sa yān// 'di mthong reg dang myong bar gyur pa gang*// go 'phang chen po'i 'bras bu myur thob cing*| |gnas skabs 'dod don lhun gyis 'grub par 'gyur// bdud bgegs log 'dren 'byung po'i rigs rnams ni// 'di yi dri tshor tsam gyis brlag par nus// bde gshegs rgyal ba rgya mtsho mnyes pa'i rdzas// dngos grub kun 'byung yid bzhin bdud rtsi'i gter// zhes dang*/ bdud rtsi'i snod ni ka pā la// bcud ni byang chub sems kyi rgyu// rkyen ni 'bru gsum nus pas byas// don ni skye 'chi med pa la// las ni nad gdon dra ba 'joms// de phyir bdud rtsi a mṛ ta// lha la phog na dgyes pa skong*// sring la phog na dam la 'du// rnal 'byor la phog sgrib pa sbyong*// dgra la phog na thal bar rlog /bgegs la phog na myos su 'jug /rdzas la phog na nus pa bskyed// gang la phog na stobs dang ldan// zhes dang*/ bskal par bsgribs pa'i gti mug mun pa yang*// sprin mthong nyi shar khud par dro ba bzhin// bdud rtsi'i rgyal po dbang chen 'di yin pas// rig 'dzin rgyal po gtso bo'i go 'phang 'thob// ces dang*// tshe dang skong dang yid du 'ong*// nad dang bral nas ci 'dod pa// bgegs rnams zhi ba la sogs pa// yon tan rtsa brgyad de yis 'grub// ces sogs gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi yon tan dpag tu med par gsungs kyang yi ger 'jigs pas cung zad tsam smos pa dag go// gsang chen lam gyi dam rdzas khyad par can// ri mor bris pa'i mar me ji bzhin du// yin rlom mang yang don dang mthun pa dag /rtsa gsum dgongs pa 'dus pa las gzhan ci// zhes chos sman gyi dkar chag nyung ngur smos pa'ang*/ rdo rje 'dzin pa pad+ma badz+ra rtsal zhes sam/ 'bri gung pa rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pas/ sa sbrul cho 'phrul zla ba'i phyogs phyi ma'i rgyal ba dang por pho brang bkra shis tshugs su mgyogs par bris pa dag go/
